What do these columns mean?
Betthe side we like: O/U a win line, Yes/No otherwise
Marketthe market's chance for that side (its Kalshi price), with American odds
Modelour chance for that side, with fair odds
Edge¢model minus market after fees, in cents
eROIexpected return: edge ÷ the price paid
Best Betstight, well-traded books, 25%+ eROI, 3¢+ edge after fees, 500+ contracts to take at that price; Liquid = the busiest books; Clear = every market, no filters
Takecontracts resting on the side a taker order eats through, at the current price — how much you could actually get filled
Advanced viewfull book plus the maker numbers, resting 1¢ inside it, after its own (often lower) fee
Tiptap a team for its card
